gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that {@link QCodec} performs a round trip: encoding a plain string into its Q (RFC 1522) form and decoding it back yields the original string.
ADDED i2: A string mixing the unsafe characters '=', SPACE, CR and LF, which Q encoding must escape as =3D, kept-space, =0D and =0A respectively.
ADDED i3: Encoding wraps the text in the "=?charset?Q?...?=" envelope and escapes the unsafe characters.
ADDED i4: Decoding the encoded form must reproduce the original text exactly.
